node.label: Decreased activity of mitochondrial ATP synthase complex
node.definition: A reduction in the activity of the mitochondrial proton-transporting ATP synthase complex, which makes ATP via oxidative phosphorylation, and is sometimes described as Complex V of the electron transport chain.

diseases.label: mitochondrial DNA depletion syndrome, myopathic form
